epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase categorization rate of out-of-control review concerns to 100%
requirements: R1: Assign the uncategorized design review concern event (stream 'reviewConcerns', u=0.0000 outside limits at epic sequence #13) a specific rootCausePatternId by implementing the categorization logic locally in a Java Service and Event class.

slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% of targeted uncategorized events are correctly assigned a rootCausePatternId

epics.title: Unified SPA Navigation Hub
epics.jtbd: When an employee accesses the platform, I want to navigate between the catalog, dossier analytics, root cause categorization, and GDPR settings from a single page without reloads, so that I have a unified and efficient workflow.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce navigation distance from index to any functional module to <= 1 click
requirements: R1: Create a unified header on the main page (index.html) with navigation tabs for Catalog, Dossier Analytics, Root Cause Categorization, and GDPR/Privacy.
R2: Implement SPA client routing to switch tabs without page reloads.
R3: Integrate existing components (DossierBuilder.svelte, RootCauseService, PrivacySettings.svelte) into the tabs.
R4: Mask technical logs and isolate service files.

slices.title: Implement SPA Navigation and Tab Routing
slices.jtbd: When implementing the SPA navigation hub for this epic, I want to create a unified header and tab routing, so that users can navigate modules without page reloads.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the main index.html page is loaded
When the user clicks the '#tab-dossier' or '#tab-privacy' tabs
Then the corresponding functional module is displayed without page reload
Given the UI is rendered
When evaluated for accessibility and design laws
Then it meets WCAG 2.1 level AA contrast, Fitts's Law minimum 44x44px interactive zones, and Miller's Law max 9 blocks
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% successful loading of functional modules within 1 click

slices.title: Verify SPA Hub Navigational Connectivity
slices.jtbd: When verifying the SPA navigation hub for this epic, I want to confirm module reachability, so that the unified workflow functions reliably end-to-end.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the fully integrated SPA application
When a user navigates from the main page to any functional module
Then the navigation distance is <= 1 click
Given the SPA application is running
When tested via headless Playwright
Then desktop at 1440px and mobile at 375px screenshots are generated and saved at precise designated .eneik/records/ paths
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% test coverage for SPA tab routing transitions

epics.title: Measurement (GQM) for SPA Hub Integration
epics.jtbd: When operating the unified portal, I want to measure the average click distance and successful tab load rates (Question 1: Is the navigation distance from index to any functional module <= 1 click? Question 2: Do tabs load without errors?), so that I know the consolidation reduces Lean waste.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: 100% of tabs load successfully within <= 1 click
requirements: R1: Measure the click distance to functional modules and track tab load success rates.

slices.title: Instrument SPA Navigation Telemetry
slices.jtbd: When implementing measurement for this epic, I want to track click distance and tab load successes, so that the consolidation's effectiveness is proven.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the SPA application is actively used

Given the measurement instrumentation is complete
When verified by QA
Then Unit and E2E tests thoroughly verify the correct tracking of telemetry metrics
